home.title: A puzzle is waiting for you today. Ready?

auth.forgot_help: Set a new password with the reminder word from sign-up.
auth.reminder_help: If you forget the password, we ask for this word. Pick one you will remember.
auth.reset_missing: The link is missing. Ask for a new one from the login page.

games.title: Games
games.loadError: Games could not be loaded. Is the backend running?
games.waking: The server was asleep and is waking up. On a phone this can take a minute.

play.crossHint: Tap once to fill, twice for ×, thrice to clear. × is only for you and is ignored when checking.
play.edgeCrossHint: Tap once for a fence, twice for ×, thrice to clear. × edges are ignored when checking.
play.notesHint: With Notes on, typed digits stay small. Turn Notes off to write the final number.
play.incorrectCells: Some cells are wrong. Try again.
play.rejected: The score was not saved. The solution could not be verified.
play.loading: The server is waking up and the puzzle is being prepared. This can take a minute.
play.unavailable: The puzzle could not be opened. Try again in a moment.
play.numbersDone: You tapped them all in order!
play.noFit: That piece does not fit. Rotate it or try another cell.
play.anchor: Pick a piece, rotate it, then click a cell it should cover. Click a filled cell to lift that piece.
play.noScores: No saved scores for this game yet.

gameRules.kakuro: Digits in each white run are different and add up to the clue above or to the left.
gameRules.sudoku: Each row, column, and bold box contains the digits 1–9 once.
gameRules.bolgesel-sudoku: Each row, column, and colored region contains the digits 1–4 once.
gameRules.apartman: Each row and column contains heights 1–4 once. An edge number is how many buildings you can see from that side.
gameRules.cit: A number says how many of that cell's edges belong to the line. The line is one closed loop. An empty cell has no number.
gameRules.amiral-batti: A row or column number is how many ship cells sit on that line. Ships do not touch.
gameRules.sihirli-piramit: Start at the top and pick one circle on each row down to the base. A step only touches the neighboring circle below. The path uses each number once, from 1 up to the number of rows.
gameRules.patika: Join the numbered dots with a continuous path of horizontal and vertical steps.
gameRules.abc-baglama: Join matching letters with horizontal and vertical lines that do not cross.
gameRules.islem-karesi: Each row and each column reaches the result on the right or below, using the signs between the numbers. Multiply and divide before you add or subtract. Use 1–9, each once.
gameRules.kendoku: Each row and column contains 1–{{n}} once. Cages use addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.
gameRules.yildiz-savaslari: Place one star in each row, column, and colored region. Stars cannot touch, even diagonally.
gameRules.kare-karalamaca: Row and column numbers are the lengths of consecutive shaded groups.
gameRules.carpmaca: Write the product of the row header and the column header in each cell.
gameRules.futoshiki: Each row and column contains 1–{{n}} once. The < and > signs order neighboring cells.
gameRules.pentominolar: Tile the outlined area with the given five-square pieces, with no gaps or overlaps. Select a piece, rotate it, then place it.
gameRules.metaforms: Each shape and each color is used once. A green mark means the piece goes in a highlighted cell. A red mark means it stays out. A shape alone means any piece of that shape. A color alone means any piece of that color.
gameRules.numbers: Starred cells fill the equation underneath, left to right and top to bottom. A/B = C/D reads four stars in that same order. Every cell is a number from 1 to 9.
gameRules.colours: Place each palette piece once. The other cells stay empty. A check or a question mark means filled. A cross means empty. A card with a slash is a picture that does not occur.
